judge.summary: The patient called to book an appointment for knee pain. The agent incorrectly used a placeholder date of birth, which the patient corrected. The agent then successfully scheduled the appointment with the correct provider and confirmed all necessary details.

conversation_quality.notes: The agent was efficient but the initial error regarding the DOB was jarring.

agent_quality.notes: The agent failed to correctly identify the patient's DOB, instead using a placeholder value.

technical_quality.notes: Minor dead air noted in metrics.

candidate_issues.title: Agent used placeholder DOB
candidate_issues.quote: Our records show your date of birth is July fourth, two thousand.
candidate_issues.expected: Agent should ask for the DOB or verify it correctly without using a placeholder.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: Using incorrect patient data is a significant privacy and record-keeping error.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent fabricates or assigns a placeholder DOB instead of using the one given
